Noah (Finance): FYI we discovered 2 prepaid Dedicated invoices tied to a pricing experiment where we applied a vendor discount mid-period (INV-2026-0602, INV-2026-0609). Need guidance for 03/31 deferral/recognition.

Ethan (Billing): Right  we applied a promo credit 2026-03-18 that lowered the effective prepaid. Billing issued CM-10021 and CM-10022. Net prepaid amount should be basis for deferral schedule.

Alma (Rev Ops): For experiments we treat the discount as a contractual change affecting the prepaid basis from the credit date forward. Earned through 3/31 = days consumed/total days * net prepaid.

Diego (Accounting): GLs: Cash/AR 1010, Deferred Rev 2205, Revenue - Dedicated 4002, Credit Memos 2108. Sample JE to recognize earned portion:
Dr Unearned Rev (2205) - $6,250
Cr Revenue - Dedicated (4002) - $6,250
Note: reduce the deferred balance first by the credit memo amount if CM issued before month-end.

Noah (Finance): Can Billing drop a short CSV with invoice, original prepaid, credit amount, CM ref, and dates? Also need a 1-paragraph memo for the close pack explaining experiment impact.

Ethan (Billing): Will upload CSV to #finance-uploads within the hour: 1772704321-prepay-experiment.csv. It will include inv_id,start,end,orig_amt,credit_amt,cm_ref,days_used.

RevenueBot: Notification: CM-10021 and CM-10022 recorded against INV-2026-0602/0609.

Alma (Rev Ops): I'll mark these invoice IDs in the scheduler as "experiment-credit" so RevOps and Accounting see them flagged next month. We should decide whether promo credits are always applied to deferred balance vs. treated as contra-revenue (audit impact). Recommend treating as adjustment to deferred revenue for prepaids.

Diego (Accounting): Agreed to treat as adjustment to deferred revenue for now. Please include that rationale in the memo for auditors.

Noah (Finance): Thanks  once CSV and memo are in I'll post JE lines for review and attach to close pack. Closing loop soon. :white_check_mark:
